definitions: To amuse or occupy oneself pleasantly, especially when alone or without external stimulation.
To engage in activities that provide enjoyment or diversion for oneself.
examples: She likes to entertain herself by reading.
He entertained himself with a puzzle.
They will entertain themselves at the park.
I can entertain myself for hours.
We entertained ourselves during the long wait.
pastTenses: entertained oneself (simple past), has/have entertained oneself (present perfect), entertained oneself (past perfect)
